scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*|npm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm or npm" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: if command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build; else echo 'No separate build step is required'; fi
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
